content_html:
Affordable SEO packages: the Basic AI SEO plan

Our affordable SEO package for businesses that want to rank on Google and be cited in AI answers. The Basic AI SEO plan starts at ₹10,000* per month and runs as an ongoing monthly project, with its targets set for months 10 to 12.

Basic AI SEO plan price

PlanStarting price
Basic AI SEOFrom ₹10,000* per month

Basic plan targets

TargetGoalWhat it means
Domain Authority70+Target a score of 70+ to strengthen overall ranking potential site-wide.
Domain Rating70+Build backlinks toward a Domain Rating of 70+ to boost competitive standing.
AI Overview40%+Appear in 40%+ of relevant AI-generated answers across platforms like ChatGPT and Gemini.

A monthly ongoing project, with the targets to be achieved in months 10 to 12 (M10–M12).

What the Basic AI SEO plan includes

Strategy and technical foundation

  • Comprehensive competitor analysis: In-depth evaluation of your top competitors’ organic strategies, backlink profiles and keyword gaps.
  • Technical SEO assessment and fixes: Audit and optimisation of site architecture, crawlability, indexing, page speed (Core Web Vitals) and mobile-friendliness.
  • Google Search Console setup and configuration: Full setup, sitemap submission, indexing monitoring and error resolution.
  • On-page SEO optimisation: Meta titles, descriptions, H1–H6 header structure, URL architecture and internal linking across key landing pages.
  • Website content optimisation: Refining existing copy for readability, engagement, semantic relevance and keyword density without changing your brand voice.

Brand authority and AI-driven content

  • 30 keyword mapping: High-intent keyword research mapped across 30 target pages, with no keyword cannibalisation.
  • 30 custom AI prompts: A library of 30 AI prompts written for your brand, for ongoing content creation.
  • 30 FAQ sections: Schema-marked FAQ sections to capture featured snippets and answer direct search queries.
  • 30 website blogs: SEO-optimised blogs for your website, mapped to your target keywords.
  • 30 webpages optimised: On-page optimisation of 30 target pages: meta tags, headers, URLs, internal links and content.
  • 30 premium platform publications: Daily AI-written, SEO-optimised posts, each targeting one of your webpages, on platforms such as Google Sites, Blogger, WordPress, Medium, Substack, Notion, Hashnode, Beehiiv and Openinkhub.
  • 20 social platform publications: Publishing across 20 platforms: Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, X, Threads, Pinterest, Google Business, Bluesky, Mastodon, Tumblr, Telegram, Discord, WordPress, Dev.to, Reddit, Quora, Flipboard and Evernote.
  • 300 backlink submissions a month: Business and brand backlinks submitted across 300 relevant platforms every month.

Advanced search optimisation (AEO, GEO, AIO and CXO)

  • Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO): Structured data and conversational content for voice assistants and direct-answer engines such as Alexa, Siri and Google Assistant.
  • Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO): Brand footprint and content formatting so LLM search tools such as Perplexity, Gemini and ChatGPT cite and recommend your business.
  • AI Optimisation (AIO): Site-wide semantic structure adapted to search engines’ AI search layouts.
  • Conversational Experience Optimisation (CXO): Content and brand touchpoints structured for chat-based interactions across AI assistants.

Local SEO and business visibility

  • Local SEO optimisation: Targeting local search queries, geo-targeted terms and map packs in your operating regions.
  • Google Business Profile optimisation: Categories, localised descriptions, review strategy and localised posts.

Social media optimisation

  • Platforms covered: Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and Twitter (X).
  • Scope: Primary profile optimisation only: banner, logo, heading, description and NAP (name, address, phone) consistency.
  • Brand analysis: Analysis of your brand presence across social platforms, delivered as a Brand Audit Report.

Extra services (charged separately)

These are not part of the Basic plan price and can be added on extra charges:

  • ORM (online reputation management): Monitoring and managing reviews, mentions and brand sentiment, with a response strategy for negative reviews.
  • Digital PR: Media outreach, press release drafting and distribution, and earned links from news outlets.
  • Premium backlinks: Niche-specific, higher DA/DR placements beyond the standard package.
  • Multi-language blogs: Blogs translated and localised for regional or global audiences.
  • International SEO: Local pages per market, hreflang and region-specific keyword mapping.
  • Google Business Profile management: Complete management of your Google Business Profile.
  • Website development: Custom-scoped websites, including WordPress and Next.js builds with SEO-ready product, service and location pages.
  • Social media marketing: Marketing across Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn and YouTube.

What to do before you start

  1. Share Google access: Manager or admin access to Gmail, Google Business Profile, Search Console, Analytics, Tag Manager, Google Ads, Google Drive and YouTube.
  2. Share social and ads access: Facebook Page and Meta Ads Manager, Instagram and LinkedIn.
  3. Share website access: Website admin panel (CMS), web hosting account and DNS settings. Delays in access can delay the project.
  4. Send your brand assets: Text, images and brand material you own or have permission to use.
  5. Plan to change passwords at the end: Change any temporary passwords you shared once the contract ends.

How the Basic plan works

  1. Audit: Competitor analysis and a technical SEO audit of your site.
  2. Set up: Google Search Console setup, sitemap submission and fixes for indexing errors.
  3. Map: Keyword research mapped across 30 target pages.
  4. Optimise: On-page and content optimisation of the 30 pages, FAQ sections, local SEO, Google Business Profile and social profiles.
  5. Publish: Monthly blogs, premium platform posts and social posts, plus AEO, GEO, AIO and CXO work.
  6. Build authority: 300 backlink submissions every month.
  7. Reach the targets: Ongoing monthly work toward DA 70+, DR 70+ and a 40%+ AI Overview share by months 10 to 12.
